parameters.description:
`pushsafer-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `pushsafer` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Pushsafer URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters.
parameters.summary: Relay a push notification through your own Pushsafer account by posting a native Pushsafer payload to the UnitySVC gateway.
